expectations.drawer: Pointer and keyboard opening work; focus stays inside the open drawer; Escape closes and restores opener focus.
expectations.controls: Every advertised control, including view changes and downloads, performs its advertised action using unforced input.
expectations.responsive: Same functional expectations at desktop1440x960 and mobile390x844 without horizontal overflow or inaccessible controls.
expectations.reduced: Reduced-motion completes task and controls without requiring decorative animation.
expectations.fallback: Rendering fallback preserves usable task, controls, and output.
expectations.evidence: Normal viewport video includes navigation/entrance, work, interruptions, and useful final result; hashes tie source, runtime, and video together.

plan.text:
A CLOSER LOOK
✕
EXAMPLE ARTIFACT / COMPLETE
A neighborhood
repair café.

ONE AFTERNOON · 20 VISITORS · COMMUNITY ROOM

A welcoming afternoon for mending clothes and assessing small household items. Invite visitors to bring one item each; match repairs to the volunteers’ experience.

Before the doors open
Confirm the room, tables, accessible entrance, and power access with the venue.
Recruit a host, a queue coordinator, and four repair volunteers. Ask each volunteer which repairs they can safely offer.
Gather sewing kits, hand tools, spare buttons, labels, and a sign-in sheet. Volunteers bring any specialist equipment.
Invite 20 neighbors. Explain that repairs are voluntary and a fix is not guaranteed.
The afternoon
12:30
Set up three repair tables, a welcome desk, and a waiting area. Check tools and brief the volunteers.
13:00
Welcome visitors. Note each item, assign a table, and explain the process.
13:15
Begin repairs. Invite owners to learn alongside the volunteers. Keep the queue visible.
15:30
Take the final items and share care tips. Record repaired, referred, and unfinished items.
16:00
Close, tidy the room, and thank the crew. Gather one suggestion for the next café.
A few useful boundaries

Start with textiles and simple, non-electrical household repairs. Refer electrical or specialist work to qualified professionals. Confirm venue requirements before the event and keep walkways clear.

This plan is a fixed illustration of coordinated work, not a live AI-generated result.

ANTHROPIC ANTS
